name: BLS International Services Limited
summary: BLS International Services Limited provides outsourcing and administrative tasks of visa, passport, and consular services to diplomatic missions in the Middle East, Asia-Pacific, North America, Europe, Africa, South America, China, and India. It operates in two segments, Rendering of Visa and Other Allied Services; and Digital Services. The company offers visa processing, such as end-to-end outsourced visa application intake and processing; appointment scheduling and queue management; document completeness verification and quality checks; biometric data collection, including fingerprints and photographs; and secure transmission of application data to embassy/consulate systems.
